done

`Parameter`, `Option` and `Argument` (plus `batch` and `_check_iter`, which only they used) now live in `src/click/params.py`. Outside `tests/test_utils`, the suite gives 2054 passed, 24 skipped and 1 xfailed (the xfail is `tests/test_chain.py::test_group_chaining`). I didn't separate out the `tests/test_utils` failures beyond that; the ones I saw were `test_echo_via_pager` cases.

`click.core.Parameter`, `Option` and `Argument` are now looked up lazily through a module-level `__getattr__` in `core.py`. This avoids a circular import, since `params.py` imports from `core.py`. A check confirmed that `click.core`, `click.params` and `click` all return the same classes. The five `isinstance` checks inside `core.py` now import `Option`/`Argument` inside the method.

I also pointed the imports in `__init__.py`, `decorators.py`, `shell_completion.py`, `parser.py`, `exceptions.py` and `types.py` at `click.params`. I removed the imports that became unused in `core.py`, but ruff isn't installed here, so lint wasn't run. I checked for unused imports with a small AST script instead. No tests were modified.
